description: Explosive Trap Level 60 520 Mana Instant 30 sec cooldown Requires Hunter Requires level 54 Place a Fire trap that explodes when an enemy approaches, causing 208 to 264 Fire damage and 330 additional Fire damage over 20 sec to all within 10 yards. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Fire trap can be active at a time.
name: Explosive Trap
